message: Nothing was changed: 1 block cannot be rotated: 1 first move of the selection that would miss the moved path. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: G91 G1 X5. Y5.: this first move of the selection starts where the lines above the selection leave the tool, and that point is not moved with the selection, so an arc, a move that continues the direction of the block before it (CT, DEP), an incremental move or (on a lathe) a move without Z, or without Y away from the turning axis, from there would miss the moved path. Start the selection at a block that moves to an absolute position, with Z on a lathe (and Y where Y is not 0).
